question.text: The degeneracy of hydrogen atom that has energy equal to $\frac{-R_{\mathrm{H}}}{9}$ is (where, $R_{\mathrm{H}}=$ Rydberg constant)

solution.text:
The energy is given as, $E=-\frac{R_{\mathrm{H}}}{9}...(i)$
We know that,
$\begin{aligned}
E_n & =-\frac{R_{\mathrm{H}}}{n^2} ...(ii)\\
n^2 & =9 \\
n & =3
\end{aligned}$
When $n=3, l=0,1,2$
$(3 s, 3 p, 3 d \text { sub-shells) }$
Orbitals present (i.e., degeneracy),
$3 s=1,3 p=3,3 d=5$
Total number of orbital present $=3+1+5=9$
